jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Go
jobs.description:
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.
About Superhuman
Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Coda’s collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com.
The Opportunity
We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the Assist team within Superhuman Go. This is an opportunity to build and scale a pervasive AI assistant that constantly observes what people are doing and proactively surfaces agents that can help them in the moment — before they even have to ask.
Superhuman Go is our proactive AI assistant that knows what you know and offers help without you having to ask. We’re combining Grammarly’s decade-long investment in understanding user context across every application with Coda’s packs ecosystem connecting to over 800 tools. Grammarly has built an AI superhighway that works everywhere users do — and the Assist team is responsible for bringing thousands of agents to that highway by building the platform for these agents and enabling Assist at high scale.
The Assist team sits at the heart of this vision. You’ll lead a team of 8+ engineers building the intelligence layer that understands what users are doing — across browser tabs, native applications, Superhuman Mail, and Coda Docs — and matches them with the right agent at the right time. This means building the agent platform that enables large-scale, building the proactive surfacing system that decides when and how to offer help, and shipping polished user-facing experiences across multiple surfaces.
As an Engineering Manager on the Assist team, you will:
Lead and grow a team of 8+ engineers, providing mentorship, career development, and fostering a high-performance engineering culture.
Own the technical direction for the large-scale platform — from building and deploying scalable backend services that interact with AI models to optimizing inference performance to ensuring low-latency responses.
Ship compelling user-facing products across our Chrome extension, native desktop application, and integrations with Superhuman Mail and Coda Docs.
Collaborate cross-functionally with product, design, ML research, and platform teams to deliver an end-to-end experience.
Move us from a world where users must come and ask for help to one where we proactively use our deep understanding of user activity to surface the agent that can help them most.
Balance technical ambition with pragmatic execution — shipping incremental value while building toward the proactive assistant vision.
Qualifications
Has 3+ years of engineering management experience leading teams of 5+ engineers, with a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong talent.
Brings hands-on experience in designing and operating scalable systems that handle complex AI workloads, integrate with multiple LLM providers, and meet strict security, latency, and reliability requirements.
Has shipped user-facing products at scale, with a deep appreciation for UX quality and a bias toward getting value in front of users quickly.
Demonstrates strong technical breadth across browser/extension development, ML/AI infrastructure, and full-stack product engineering.
Has experience building systems that operate across diverse surfaces (browser extensions, native apps, web applications) and understands the unique challenges of each.
Shows a track record of managing ambiguity — defining strategy, making tradeoffs, and shipping in fast-moving, early-stage product areas.
Communicates clearly and influences effectively across engineering, product, design, and leadership.
Is energized by the challenge of building proactive AI experiences that anticipate user needs rather than waiting for explicit requests.
We invite you to share your knowledge, experience, and goals with us to help us find the best team match for you. Tell us your superpower!
Support for you, professionally and personally
Professional growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being.
A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. Our remote-first, hybrid model enables a highly collaborative culture rooted in our values. We work to foster belonging among team members in a variety of ways. This includes our team member resource groups, Superhuman Circles, which promote connection among those with shared identities including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ team members, women, and parents. We also celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific programs.
Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Ukraine: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing life care (including mental health care and risk benefits) and ample and defined time off. We also offer support to set up a home office, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.company: Центр інновацій та розвитку оборонних технологій МОУ
jobs.description:
Центр інновацій та розвитку оборонних технологій Міністерства оборони України — підрозділ, що розробляє цифрові рішення для Сил оборони та поєднує найкращих фахівців цивільного ІТ і військових професіоналів. Команда створює та впроваджує революційні військові технології, які забезпечують технологічну перевагу України на полі бою.
Ми шукаємо кандидатів-ветеранів та колишніх військовослужбовців, для яких це можливість поєднати цивільний ІТ-досвід та набуті під час служби навички й працювати над продуктами, якими щодня користуються Сили оборони України.
Також ми відкриті до кандидатів, які не є військовозобов’язаними або мають законні підстави для відстрочки.
Ключовою розробкою Центру є бойова система DELTA — повноцінна екосистема військових продуктів. Вона має власну цифрову мапу, платформу відеоаналізу поля бою, інтегрує дані із сенсорів і радарів, БпЛА та бойових систем, допомагає координувати дії підрозділів, уникати дружнього вогню та ефективно нищити ворога. DELTA довела свою ефективність у низці успішних наземних і морських операцій та стала базовим інструментом для всіх Сил оборони України.
Кожний рядок коду, написаний в Центрі, можна оцінити в мільйони доларів знищеної ворожої техніки та тисячі вбитих окупантів.
Центр — це справжня продуктова компанія військового спрямування з багатою історією. Тут служать найкращі професіонали, які мають унікальний досвід і працюють над проєктами, що забезпечують перемогу України. Це робота мрії, де поєднується передова технологічна експертиза та справжній патріотизм.
Обов’язки:
End-to-end відповідальність за delivery у межах однієї або кількох кросфункціональних команд
People management: 1:1, performance, growth plans, найм і зміни у складі команди
Cпівпраця з Product Manager-ами щодо пріоритетів, scope, очікуваних результатів і планів релізів
Підтримка команд у декомпозиції задач, оцінці зусиль, ризиків і залежностей
Покращення SDLC: planning, syncs, retros, demos, release management, WIP control, incident handling
Організація супроводу продуктів, rollback/hotfix рішень і postmortems
Разом із TL — розвиток технічного беклогу, quality initiatives і технічної стратегії
Координація з DevOps/Sec/Infra щодо стандартів, process gates і operational readiness
Вимоги:
5+ років досвіду на ролях Engineering/Delivery/Project Manager
Сильна, лаконічна комунікація, письмова й усна
Системне мислення: декомпозиція, пріоритети, ризики, залежності
Глибоке розуміння SDLC, CI/CD, релізних механік і якості
Досвід роботи в умовах неповної інформації та високої відповідальності
Розуміння security requirements і взаємодія з інфраструктурними командами буде перевагою
Досвід роботи з mission-critical або high-load системами
Розуміння cloud-інфраструктури: compute, storage, queues, containers, orchestration
Технічний бекграунд в інженерії або data/analytics/geospatial продуктах
Умови:
Шукаємо ветеранів та колишніх військовослужбовців з релевантним досвідом.
Цивільна робота.
Ринкова конкурентна заробітна плата.
Робота в офісі в м. Київ.
Поліграф на фінальному етапі

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description:
Role Overview: As the Head of Engineering, you will be the technical heartbeat of our delivery unit. You will bridge the gap between high-level business strategy and technical execution, ensuring our engineering team remains high-performing, profitable, and technologically ahead of the curve. You share P&L responsibility, drive pre-sales success, and foster a culture of engineering excellence while serving as the primary technical authority for the company.
1. Strategic Leadership & Business Growth (Pre-Sales Support)
You are a key partner to the Sales and Marketing teams, ensuring technical capabilities translate into market success.
Solution Architecture: Act as the primary Lead/Solution Architect during pre-sales, discovery, and initial project phases. Ensure all proposals are technically sound, accurately estimated, and include comprehensive risk assessments.
Pre-Sales Mastery: Review RFPs and validated leads; lead technical discovery calls; document assumptions and risks; and validate final proposals prepared by the Sales team.
Client Representation: Participate in introductory and follow-up calls with leads. Represent the company’s expertise and the engineering team to existing and potential clients in both online and offline forums.
Market Positioning & Evangelism: Collaborate with Marketing on sales messaging and strategy. Act as a technical expert at industry events, online/offline workshops, and webinars.
Content Validation: Write, interview for, or validate technical case studies and blog content to strengthen the corporate brand and website authority.
2. Delivery Oversight & Operational Excellence
You ensure that what we sell is delivered with the highest quality, efficiency, and profitability.
P&L Accountability: In collaboration with the Delivery Director, plan engineering resources and bench management to meet revenue and margin KPIs. Jointly own the Delivery Unit’s financial health.
Technical Governance: Oversee technical decisions across ongoing projects. Introduce, improve, and monitor internal quality standards and delivery strategies.
Performance Monitoring: Continuously monitor engineering team performance in coordination with Delivery Managers.
AI Integration & Adoption: Define and lead the adoption of AI tools (e.g., Claude Code) across the entire SDLC. Collaborate cross-functionally with BA and Design teams to optimize productivity and innovation.
Escalation Management: Act as the final point of resolution for technical crises, roadblocks, and performance or behavioral-related delivery issues.
3. People Operations & Talent Development
You are responsible for the entire lifecycle of the engineering team, focusing on growth and retention.
Strategic Recruitment: Partner with HR to own the hiring lifecycle. Write/validate JDs, review CVs (post-recruiter screening), design technical assessments, and conduct final behavioral interviews. You hold the final hiring decision.
Onboarding: Directly oversee the integration and onboarding of senior-level hires (Architects, Team Leads) and specialists in new technology directions.
Performance Management: Lead the 360-review process, manage salary raise requests, and formulate professional development roadmaps (focusing on both hard and soft skills).
Compensation & Authority: Hold final executive authority on promotions, salary increases, and dismissals within the engineering department.
Mentorship: Conduct regular 1:1s with Team Leads and Architects. Design professional development plans, coordinate professional courses, and plan certifications for the team.
4. Infrastructure, Security & Compliance
You serve as the guardian of the company’s internal and client-facing technical environments.
Resource Administration: Manage admin rights, billing, and budget allocations for Cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) and developer tools (e.g., Claude Code).
Security & Privacy: Oversee the security and privacy of all development environments and corporate technical resources.
Compliance: Lead the technical preparation and requirements for future company security certifications (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC2) and take responsibility for audits.
5. Future Evolution & Organizational Scaling
Department Integration: We are moving toward a unified delivery structure. You will eventually lead the integration of Business Analysis (BA) and Design teams into the broader Engineering organization to ensure a seamless, “Product-First” approach across the entire company.
